title: Defining equation of the chosen normalized affine comparison
statement: For a compact separated scheme Y, a quasi-coherent module F, and q a natural number, affineRealizationComparison Y F q equals the inverse of the family selected by exists_unique_qcoherentNormalizedComparison Y [def-weil-pbc-affine-cohomology-comparison-data]. Equivalently it is the inverse of the constructed affineNormalizedComparisonFamily [def-weil-pbc-affine-normalized-comparison-family].

source.place: Tags 03P2 and 03FD; defining equation of the canonical normalized affine comparison.

proof.text: Unfold affineRealizationComparison to obtain its inverse-choice equation. Unfold the named affineNormalizedComparisonFamily and apply that equation to identify the inverse named family with the existing comparison. The definitions use the same unique-existence theorem and the same witness, so no new choice is introduced. The statement holds on empty schemes, zero modules and in every degree.

from.place: Identify the inverse chosen normalized comparison on each affine chart.

lean.statement:
theorem affineRealizationComparison_eq_chosen (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace Y] [Y.IsSeparated] (F : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ) :
    affineRealizationComparison Y F q =
      (Classical.choose (exists_unique_qcoherentNormalizedComparison Y) F q).symm
